article.headline: Malaysia Smashes Singapore 6-0 in Heaviest Defeat Since 1978 Historic Loss
article.summary: Singapore was eliminated from the FIFA ASEAN Cup on October 1 after suffering a 6-0 defeat to Malaysia.
article.body:
The 6-0 result marked Singapore's worst loss to Malaysia at the senior level since 1978, a margin that ended the Lions' inaugural campaign in the FIFA ASEAN Cup. Bergson da Silva led the charge with a hat-trick, while Stuart Wilkin, Paulo Josue, and Syahir Bashah added goals to complete the rout at Si Jalak Harupat Stadium in Bandung. 

This defeat serves as a sobering reality check for the squad just three months before the Asian Cup. Coach Gavin Lee noted that while the match did not feel like a six-goal gap on the pitch, the team failed to do what was necessary to remain in contention. The result leaves Singapore third in Group A with three points, missing out on the final stages of the tournament. 

Malaysia, despite their dominant performance, also failed to secure a spot in the final, finishing second in the group behind Indonesia on goal difference. The Lions struggled throughout the match as Malaysia pushed aggressively for goals after establishing their early lead. 

Looking ahead, Malaysia is expected to compete in the Division 1 third-place play-off on October 5, likely against Vietnam. Singapore concludes their tournament journey following this final group stage encounter.

article.headline: PRC Releases September 2026 Civil Engineer Licensure Exam Results Nationwide
article.summary: The Professional Regulation Commission released the list of successful civil engineering examinees on October 2, 2026.
article.body:
The Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) officially released the names of successful examinees for the September 2026 Civil Engineer Licensure Examination (CELE) on October 2, 2026. This release comes exactly five working days after the conclusion of the board examinations, which took place on September 26-27, 2026. The official list marks the culmination of the assessment process overseen by the Board of Civil Engineering, led by Chairperson Engr. Praxedes P. Bernardo alongside members Engr. Pericles P. Dakay and Engr. Romeo A. Estañero.

For the thousands of examinees who took the tests, the publication of these results is a critical milestone in their professional development, granting them the credentials required to practice as civil engineers across the country. The examination was administered simultaneously across multiple testing centers to accommodate candidates from various regions, including NCR, Baguio, Butuan, Cagayan de Oro, Calapan, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Koronadal, Legazpi, Lucena, Pagadian, Palawan, Pampanga, Rosales, Tacloban, Tuguegarao, Zamboanga, and Ilocos Sur.

Candidates can access the complete Roll of Successful Examinees through the official PRC channels. The publication of this list provides the definitive confirmation for those who have satisfied the licensure requirements established by the board. This specific set of results is distinct from other professional examinations held concurrently, such as the Geodetic Engineers Computer-Based Licensure Examination, where high-ranking performers have also recently been recognized for their academic achievements.

While the Board of Civil Engineering has fulfilled the requirement to post the results within the designated five-day window, successful candidates are encouraged to check the official government platforms for further instructions regarding the registration process and the upcoming oathtaking ceremony, which serves as the final formal step before entering professional practice.

article.headline: Oilers blast four first-period goals to silence Canucks at Rogers Arena
article.summary: The Edmonton Oilers surged to a 4-0 lead in the opening period against the Vancouver Canucks on Thursday.
article.body: The Edmonton Oilers stormed to a 4-0 lead before the first intermission on Thursday, punishing the Vancouver Canucks at Rogers Arena with a flurry of early goals. The outburst began when Vasily Podkolzin buried a back-door feed on the power play, followed by a milestone moment as Owen Michaels netted his first career NHL goal just minutes later. The Oilers maintained their relentless pace, with Evan Bouchard scoring on a pinball deflection only 16 seconds after Michaels, before Ryan Shea capped the period by converting a pass from Connor McDavid. With McDavid recording three assists in the opening frame, the Oilers established complete control against a Vancouver side that had characterized the rematch as a potential "whole different animal" following their season-opening win earlier in the week. The scoring blitz highlights a sharp response from Edmonton, who entered the contest looking to overcome an "unacceptable" effort in their previous loss to the Canucks. The efficiency of the Oilers' top-tier talent was on full display as they forced the Canucks onto their heels throughout the opening twenty minutes, leaving the home team struggling to recover from the deficit. With the Oilers moving through the defense with ease, the match served as a stark contrast to the tighter season opener, as Edmonton exploited defensive gaps and capitalized on high-pressure offensive sequences. The team continues to navigate personnel changes, including the absence of Hyman, who remains sidelined for up to two weeks with an upper-body injury, and the rotation of young talent in the net. The Oilers look to maintain this offensive momentum as the season progresses, having sent a clear message to the Canucks early in their schedule.

article.headline: Putin Vows To Use Every Available Weapon To Protect Russian Kaliningrad Exclave
article.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin declared at the Valdai foreign policy forum that Moscow will deploy all weapons at its disposal if Kaliningrad faces a direct attack.
article.body:
The Russian president emphasized that he is not threatening any nation, but is responding directly to Western concerns regarding potential conflict scenarios projected for 2029 or 2030. Moscow continues to accuse NATO of planning a blockade against the territory, which sits between Lithuania and Poland, while officials hint that nuclear capabilities could be utilized if the region is severed from the rest of Russia. These escalations follow recent accusations from the Baltic nations and Poland regarding a surge in hybrid warfare incidents, including the unauthorized entry of a Russian helicopter into Polish airspace and frequent drone incursions in Lithuania.

This rhetoric creates immediate uncertainty for neighboring Baltic states that already report feeling constantly threatened by Russian military maneuvers. For international observers, the inclusion of nuclear threats in policy discussions marks a significant hardening of Russia’s stance toward NATO’s defensive posture in Northern Europe. The situation remains volatile as nations like Germany increase their own security preparations, citing recent findings of explosives-laden drones at civilian transport hubs.

During his address at the Valdai forum, Putin stated that he expects international conflicts to persist while arguing that the global status quo will improve as Western hegemony weakens. He signaled no intent to de-escalate, maintaining that current geopolitical frictions are largely driven by Western interference rather than Russian aggression. NATO has countered these claims by reaffirming its role as a purely defensive alliance and explicitly calling for an end to the ongoing nuclear brinkmanship from the Kremlin.

Looking ahead, officials in the Baltics and Poland remain on heightened alert for further hybrid attacks. Meanwhile, German leaders have begun preparing for the potential of more sophisticated sabotage efforts within their own borders, as European security agencies continue to monitor the movement of Russian assets near the exclave’s borders.

article.headline: Sir Alex Ferguson admits terror before emotional 2018 Old Trafford comeback
article.summary: Sir Alex Ferguson returned to Old Trafford less than four months after emergency brain surgery in 2018, fearing he would not receive a warm welcome.
article.body: I was terrified, says Sir Alex Ferguson, who admitted he was far from comfortable ahead of his first appearance at Old Trafford following his life-threatening brain haemorrhage in May 2018. The legendary Manchester United manager, who spent 26 years winning 38 trophies, feared how supporters would react after being sidelined by emergency surgery. He watched the team play to a 1-1 draw against Wolves just months after being in intensive care at Salford Royal Hospital. The return provided a moment of relief as he and his wife, Cathy, received a standing ovation when they took their seats in the directors’ box. His wife, who guided him through his recovery, was nearly moved to tears by the reception from the Old Trafford crowd. The former manager revealed the ordeal left him fighting to regain his voice, a frightening symptom that hampered his ability to communicate with his own grandsons in the days following his surgery. He eventually regained his speech through therapy, which included tasks like writing down names of animals and rivers. Now 84 years old, Ferguson remains a regular fixture at Old Trafford, noting that he is feeling quite good despite some small injuries. His reflection on his career and the life-changing medical scare comes as he prepares for the release of his new book, 'Games of My Life,' which documents 21 matches that defined his journey from Glasgow to the pinnacle of European football.

article.headline: Portugal silences Denmark 4-2 in Copenhagen to maintain perfect group record
article.summary: Portugal secured a 4-2 win against Denmark in the UEFA Nations League Group A4 to extend their winning streak.
article.body:
Vitinha netted his first senior international goal for Portugal, breaking a 2-2 deadlock to help steer the visitors to a 4-2 victory in Copenhagen. This result marked a third consecutive win for the side under manager Jorge Jesus, keeping them undefeated in their Nations League group campaign. Despite the high-profile absence of Cristiano Ronaldo, who departed the squad prior to the match, the team demonstrated significant attacking depth and tactical discipline throughout the ninety minutes.

For the Selecao, maintaining this momentum is critical as they navigate a highly competitive group stage. The victory not only confirms their current form—boasting nine wins across their last 13 matches—but also solidifies their standing in the tournament after dealing with multiple equalizing efforts from the hosts. For Denmark, the match highlights the challenge of containing a multi-faceted attack, even after Rasmus Højlund leveled the score early in the second half.

João Cancelo opened the scoring in the 13th minute before Mikkel Damsgaard responded for Denmark. Gonçalo Ramos restored Portugal's lead in the 25th minute, though the hosts drew level again via Højlund shortly after the break. Following Vitinha’s decisive header, João Félix sealed the result with a late strike. According to The Guardian, Jorge Jesus praised the performance as a display of the highest quality that set a new standard for his squad. Flashscore reports that the victory keeps the Selecao in command of Group A4, building on a record that has seen them suffer only one defeat in their last 13 outings.

article.headline: Carter Efe Dominates Speed Darlington In Chaos In The Ring Boxing Bout
article.summary: Carter Efe secured a technical knockout victory against Speed Darlington at the Chaos in the Ring event held on October 1, 2026.
article.body:
Carter Efe maintained his unbeaten record in the celebrity boxing series by forcing a stoppage against Speed Darlington. The four-round crossover contest ended prematurely when Efe dominated the proceedings, causing the musician to cease movement and resulting in a technical knockout win for the skit maker.

The Chaos in the Ring event, organized by Balmoral Promotions at the Federal Palace Hotel in Victoria Island, Lagos, showcased celebrity bouts that drew significant attention. For fans of the viral content creators, this matchup provided a definitive conclusion to the ongoing crossover series that pits social media personalities against one another in a professional ring setting.

Beyond the Efe and Darlington bout, the event featured historic moments as reality television star Phyna defeated Nkechi Blessing via knockout in Nigeria’s first female celebrity boxing match. Phyna, who claimed a ₦50m prize for her performance, immediately turned her sights to actress Etinosa Idemudia. After Phyna publicly stated her intent to settle personal disputes in the ring, Etinosa accepted the challenge from ringside. The main event of the evening saw Seth "Freezy Macbones" Gyimah dethrone Godday "Zodsolo" Appah.

While Carter Efe has solidified his standing within this specific celebrity circuit, the organizers have not yet announced the dates for subsequent events. Following the vocal exchange between Phyna and Etinosa at the ringside, spectators now wait to see if the proposed bout between the two celebrities will be finalized for a future edition of the Chaos in the Ring series.

article.headline: 7300 people report violent 5.3 magnitude quake hitting New Zealand's North Island
article.summary: A magnitude 5.3 earthquake struck 25km east of New Plymouth early Friday morning, jolting thousands of residents across the North Island.
article.body: One resident described the early-morning tremor as the worst experience in 78 years, while another compared the impact to a bomb causing the floor of a shed to jump upwards. Reports across the region detailed a loud rumble followed by sharp shaking that sent pictures, pot plants, and household items crashing to the floor. The quake hit at 2:57 a.m. at a depth of 11km, according to data from GeoNet, which officially classified the event as strong shaking. More than 7,300 people across the North Island reported feeling the motion, with about 4,000 residents noting moderate to strong intensity. For many, the incident served as a stark reminder of earthquake safety protocols, with monitoring services reiterating the importance of the drop, cover, and hold procedure during active seismic events. While the shaking caused some belongings to break and left some residents without internet access for up to 20 minutes, Fire and Emergency New Zealand confirmed by 3:25 a.m. that they had received no emergency callouts related to the tremor. In contrast, a separate, smaller magnitude 3.7 earthquake occurred in the Lake Tahoe area of California at 3:00 a.m. on the same day. That quake hit at a depth of approximately 4 miles, about 6 miles west-southwest of South Lake Tahoe. While tremors were believed to have been felt in Reno and Carson City, Nevada, there were no initial reports of shaking submitted to the United States Geological Survey, and no information regarding damage or injuries was available.

article.headline: Arsenal Star Christos Tzolis Limps Off During Greece's Draw With Netherlands
article.summary: Greece blew a two-goal lead in a 2-2 Nations League draw against the Netherlands as Arsenal's Christos Tzolis exited with an injury in the 18th minute.
article.body:
Christos Tzolis lasted only 18 minutes on the pitch in Thessaloniki before pulling up with an apparent hamstring or quad injury, leaving the field with his shirt covering his face. The 23-year-old winger, a £34million summer signing for Arsenal who has started all five of their Premier League games this season, now faces an anxious wait for scans to determine the severity of the muscle damage. 

For Arsenal, the injury adds to a growing list of concerns during the international break, as they have already seen Germany’s Kai Havertz sidelined with a hamstring issue. While Tzolis's departure was the major headline for his club, the match itself saw Greece build a promising 2-0 advantage before the Dutch mounted a second-half resurgence. 

Fotis Ioannidis opened the scoring for Greece and provided the assist for Giorgos Masouras to double the lead. However, a halftime triple substitution by Netherlands manager Xavi Hernandez altered the momentum. Virgil van Dijk narrowed the gap with a header to mark his 99th cap, and substitute Tijjani Reijnders later lashed in the equalizer to secure a point. 

Both nations remain unbeaten in Group A2 following the result. While Greece and the Netherlands focus on their standings, Arsenal remains in contact with staff to assess when Tzolis can return to London Colney for further medical evaluation. The injury follows a busy stretch for the forward, who had played three matches during the current international window.

article.headline: Britain Left Stranded as EU Talks Tackle Massive Diesel Reserve Release
article.summary: The UK faces fuel supply uncertainty after being excluded from urgent European discussions regarding a proposal to release 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil.
article.body:
French President Emmanuel Macron initiated a urgent proposal to release 50 million barrels of diesel and 50 million barrels of crude oil to combat critical shortages. This move follows direct demands from the White House for a massive drawdown of European reserves to curb rising fuel costs. While leaders from France and other EU nations gathered to formalize the plan, Britain was notably absent from the discussions held Thursday night. This exclusion leaves the UK, which relies heavily on imports, to scramble for influence during a potential emergency meeting of G7 leaders.

The global fuel shortage stems from a volatile convergence of conflicts, including the US-led war in Iran and Ukrainian attacks on Russian refining capacity. As a result of these disruptions, crude oil supplies have plummeted and Russia has implemented export bans. For British consumers and transport officials, the situation is increasingly dire as the UK faces record-high forecourt prices. The government's dependence on American diesel, which typically accounts for a significant portion of its supply, creates a high-stakes vulnerability if the US follows through on threats to ban exports to stabilize its own domestic market ahead of the November elections.

Transport Minister Keir Mather confirmed that the UK is attempting to maintain close ties with US counterparts to keep fuel supplies flowing. However, the Telegraph reports that Britain is currently playing catch-up after being sidelined from the European strategy sessions. The pressure on the country reflects a broader structural weakness in its fuel stockpiles, which may now be drained as part of a deal negotiated largely between the US and EU capitals. Officials must now navigate the G7 emergency meeting to ensure the UK is not left behind in the international response to the fuel crunch.

article.headline: Trump Says Canada Being Taught A Little Lesson In Escalating Trade War
article.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump has imposed new tariffs on Canadian goods, leading to an impasse in trade negotiations between the two countries.
article.body:
U.S. President Donald Trump declared that Canada is being taught a little lesson, asserting that the country has taken advantage of American leadership for many years. This trade conflict holds significant implications for both nations, given the deep integration of their economies. Conversely, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney maintained that Canada remains ready to negotiate in good faith despite the recent rhetoric.

President Trump has expressed a belief that a trade agreement could be reached within weeks, suggesting that Canadian leaders will eventually come to the bargaining table to address American concerns. The current payment cycle for November is under review because the original payout dates coincide with the local government elections scheduled for 4 November 2026. President Cyril Ramaphosa previously declared this election day a public holiday to encourage participation, forcing the agency to reassess its original plan to issue disability grants on that specific date. SASSA originally published its 2026/27 financial year payment schedule in March after gaining approval from the National Treasury. However, the conflict with the electoral calendar has necessitated a pause and subsequent re-evaluation of the November distribution timeline. Spokesperson Dr. Paseka Letsatsi emphasized that the agency remains committed to distributing the correct grants to the right people at the appropriate time and place. article.headline: Lionel Messi Snaps Up Century Old Spanish Football Club CD Eldense
article.summary: Lionel Messi has acquired 100 percent of Spanish Segunda División side CD Eldense to become the club's new majority shareholder.
article.body:
The acquisition by the Argentine superstar marks a fresh chapter for the club founded in 1921, which now aims to strengthen its sporting and social infrastructure under new ownership. The deal sees Messi purchase 100 percent of the shares formerly held by the TH Soluciones Group SAS, representing his second venture into Spanish club ownership following his entry into UE Cornellà in April 2026.

For the Alicante-based club, this transition signals a long-term project designed to bolster both the team's competitiveness on the pitch and its institutional stability. By taking over the outfit, Messi adds the century-old institution to an expanding global sports investment portfolio that already includes a stake in Inter Miami CF and other regional ventures.

According to the official statement released by CD Eldense on Thursday, October 1, 2026, the move seeks to promote the club's growth while preserving its traditional blue-and-maroon identity. The arrival of a world-renowned figure is expected to generate significant international attention for the Segunda División side as it looks to consolidate its position within the professional football hierarchy.

The administrative process for the takeover has reached its final stages. The transaction currently awaits mandatory ratification from Spain's Higher Sports Council, known as the Consejo Superior de Deportes, to comply with national sports law regulations.

article.headline: WhatsApp Unlocks New Parental Controls Locked Behind A Mandatory Parent PIN
article.summary: Meta introduced optional parental controls for WhatsApp, allowing guardians to manage teen account settings and monitor group activity via a secure PIN.
article.body:
Parents can now tighten security for teenage WhatsApp users by managing who views their profile photos, who adds them to group chats, and how they interact with broadcast Channels. These settings are secured by a parent-created PIN, ensuring that any attempt by a teenager to relax these privacy restrictions requires direct approval from the guardian. While these tools offer oversight, all messages and calls remain protected by end-to-end encryption, meaning parents cannot read the content of their child's conversations.

This update addresses growing concerns regarding digital safety as young users encounter risks from cyberbullies and predators. According to Absolute Geeks, these controls also provide alerts when a teen joins or leaves a group, or when an existing group chat grows in size, helping parents identify when a personal conversation space is being populated by strangers. Additionally, parents can regulate how teenagers engage with Meta AI by selecting a stricter Limited Content mode.

Social media analyst Matt Navarra noted that the optional nature of these tools reflects Meta's strategy to balance child safety demands with user privacy. WhatsApp clarified that the minimum age for account creation remains 13, and guardians can adjust or deactivate these parental controls at any time. The rollout aims to provide families with flexible tools to help mitigate risks while maintaining the platform's focus on private communication.

article.headline: ChatGPT Virtual Try-On Feature Transforms Selfies Into Digital Fitting Room Sessions
article.summary: OpenAI launched global shopping features for ChatGPT that allow users to virtually try on clothing and save favorite items to a library.
article.body:
Your selfie or a full-body photo can now serve as a personal mannequin, as OpenAI officially rolled out a virtual try-on feature for its conversational AI. By simply uploading an image and selecting a piece of clothing, ChatGPT generates a visualization of the item on the user, providing a new way to preview apparel before purchasing. This update follows a pattern of experimentation by the company, which previously tested an instant checkout feature that did not perform to expectations.

For online shoppers, these tools offer a centralized space to curate potential purchases. Beyond the try-on function, the new Favorites library allows users to save products discovered during chats for later reference. According to Engadget, these features can be accessed wherever a product listing appears, and users are not restricted to items surfaced by the AI—any screenshot of clothing can be used to generate a try-on image.

The underlying technology powering these visuals is the ChatGPT Images 2.5 model, which OpenAI released in September. TechCrunch reports that this model is designed to produce more natural lighting, render richer textures, and follow editing instructions with higher reliability than previous versions. While these features aim to assist users in their shopping journey, OpenAI noted that images uploaded from personal accounts may be used for model training unless users actively opt out of that setting.

OpenAI continues to explore the intersection of conversational AI and retail as it seeks to integrate further into the consumer shopping experience. While the company does not operate as an online marketplace, these consistent updates to its shopping suite suggest an ongoing effort to maintain utility for users engaging with products inside the chat interface.

article.headline: Chery snatches local crown as new bakkie becomes the official Grootman
article.summary: Following a national voting campaign, Chery South Africa has officially named its upcoming double-cab hybrid bakkie the Grootman for its 2027 market debut.
article.body:
Over 20,000 name suggestions poured into Chery South Africa during a public naming competition that eventually narrowed the field down to six final contenders: Bakkie, Brahman, Chief, Orca, Nduna, and Grootman. The term Grootman, which is rooted in Afrikaans and literally translates to "big man," emerged as the winner. In South African culture, the title is a familiar expression of respect used to describe someone who has earned their standing through experience, achievement, and the ability to take responsibility when problems need solving. 

For the automaker, the name choice represents a strategic integration of local identity into its global engineering efforts. General Manager for Chery South Africa, Jay Jay Botes, stated that because South Africans themselves chose the name, the vehicle carries meaningful expectations that the company intends to live up to. The bakkie is intended to challenge established local players like the Toyota Hilux and Ford Ranger.

The vehicle, known internally as the KP31, is confirmed for a South African launch during the first quarter of 2027. Preliminary specifications for the four-wheel drive hybrid indicate it will be powered by a 2.5l turbodiesel engine paired with an electric motor. The powertrain is slated to deliver a combined output of 350kW and 800Nm, with a braked towing capacity rated at 3,500kg. While the bakkie will initially arrive as a full import, Chery is considering local assembly at its new Rosslyn plant, which is expected to begin operations in the second half of 2027. Meanwhile, the same vehicle will be marketed as the Stockman in Australia.

"Turn the page, and move on to tomorrow and show up ready to do the same thing."

The stakes for the upcoming Game 3 at Truist Park are significant, as the winner secures a spot in the NLDS to face the Dodgers. For the Phillies, a victory would mark a successful comeback after dropping the series opener, a feat rarely achieved by postseason teams. Both rosters face pitching challenges, forcing managers to rely on deep rotations and potential relief appearances from their aces to navigate the nine innings.

According to MLB.com and CBS Sports, the Phillies will start Aaron Nola, who recorded a 4.50 ERA against Atlanta during the regular season. The Braves plan to open with left-hander Raymond Kerr on the mound. While the Phillies rely on Nola to carry the initial load, there is speculation that ace Zack Wheeler could enter the game in relief if the situation requires it. Other pitchers, including Jesús Luzardo and Andrew Painter, have confirmed their availability for the bullpen as well.

The decisive Game 3 is scheduled for Thursday at 8:00 p.m. ET. The broadcast will be available on NBC and Peacock, with additional coverage on Universo and Univision Radio for Spanish-speaking fans. ESPN Radio will also provide live national audio coverage of the high-stakes matchup.

article.summary: Former Mamelodi Sundowns attacker Keletso Makgalwa joined Tanzania's Simba SC after receiving a late transfer proposal from Kaizer Chiefs.
article.body: Keletso Makgalwa turned his back on a lucrative offer from the Soweto giants to pursue a fresh start outside of South Africa. The 29-year-old winger, who recorded nine assists in 34 matches last season, opted for a move to Simba SC in Tanzania rather than joining the Premier Soccer League side. Makgalwa confirmed that while the interest from Naturena was genuine, the timing of the proposal did not align with his career plans at the time. Speaking to FARPost, the attacker clarified that he did not reject the offer outright but rather chose to prioritize an international experience over a local switch. He explained that by the time Kaizer Chiefs made their formal approach, discussions were already advanced with Simba SC. The player held direct conversations with his agent, Ntobatsi Masegela, and Kaizer Motaung Jr. during the finalization of the squad roster. Despite the missed opportunity, Makgalwa maintains that representing the Glamour Boys remains a long-term goal. He noted that playing for the club has been an objective since his youth in Mokopane and expressed a clear willingness to accept a potential move if the opportunity arises again in the future. Makgalwa is currently reflecting on his career path while attending a mid-season training camp in Polokwane, fully committed to his new chapter abroad after his stint with Sekhukhune United.

article.headline: SpaceX Falcon 9 rockets Crew-13 to orbit despite morning weather uncertainty
article.summary: Four astronauts successfully launched on a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket from Florida's Space Coast to the International Space Station at 11:10 a.m. ET on Thursday.
article.body:
The mission successfully cleared the launch pad at 11:10 a.m. despite forecasts showing only a 40% chance of favorable conditions earlier that morning. By the time of liftoff, weather conditions had improved to a 60% probability of success, allowing the Falcon 9 to carry the Dragon capsule, named Grace, into the sky. Following stage separation, the first-stage booster returned to Earth, creating a sonic boom that echoed across the Cape Canaveral Space Force Station as it touched down at Landing Zone 40.

This mission is critical for the future of human exploration beyond Earth. According to NASA, the Crew-13 team will spend their time at the International Space Station conducting a series of scientific investigations and technology demonstrations. These efforts are designed to prepare for eventual human missions to the Moon and Mars.

Commanding the spacecraft is NASA astronaut Jessica Watkins, alongside pilot Luke Delaney, a former DeBary resident. They are joined by mission specialists Joshua Kutryk from the Canadian Space Agency and Roscosmos cosmonaut Sergey Teteryatnikov. The crew arrived at the Kennedy Space Center following their departure from the Johnson Space Center in Houston.

According to WESH, the launch followed a period of quarantine and final preflight preparations for the four astronauts. Had the weather failed to cooperate on Thursday, flight controllers were prepared to attempt the launch again on Friday morning at 10:47 a.m. ET. The capsule Grace was previously utilized for the private Ax-4 mission conducted last year.

article.headline: 17 crew airlifted to safety after fishing boat strikes Orkney rocks
article.summary: The Genesis fishing vessel ran aground off the island of Hoy on October 1, prompting a major multi-agency rescue operation.
article.body:
Captain Alejandro Abuin Prado feared his 30-metre longliner would capsize after it struck rocks near the Old Man of Hoy at approximately 06:30. Every one of the 17 crew members on board was successfully winched to safety by a Coastguard helicopter and transported to Kirkwall, with no injuries reported.

The grounding of the vessel, which was carrying 28 tonnes of fish while en route to Scrabster, triggered an immediate response involving RNLI lifeboats, coastguard helicopters from Sumburgh and Stornoway, and a Royal Air Force maritime patrol aircraft. The Northlink passenger ferry Hamnavoe also diverted to assist in the operation, deploying its fast-rescue boat as the situation unfolded near the island's west coast.

According to Captain Prado, who has served on the Genesis for two years, a miscommunication on board caused the vessel to strike the rocks. While the crew remains safe, the Spanish-owned, UK-flagged vessel currently sits abandoned on the rocks. The coastguard vessel Ievoli Black is now on-site to monitor the situation, as the Maritime and Coastguard Agency and counter-pollution teams assess the environmental impact and future recovery options for the boat.

This incident adds to a complex history for the vessel, which was previously reported for a 2021 incident involving a Shetland trawler. For now, the focus remains on the vessel's status on the rocks, as authorities work to ensure the site is made safe following the successful rescue of all personnel.

article.headline: Igor Shesterkin makes history as first Rangers goalie to score a goal
article.summary: Igor Shesterkin became the 18th goaltender in NHL history to record a goal, sealing a 5-1 win over the Tampa Bay Lightning on Thursday.
article.body:
Igor Shesterkin fired a puck into the empty net with 2:34 remaining, officially becoming the 18th goaltender to score in NHL history and the very first to achieve the feat for the New York Rangers. The moment occurred during the Rangers' home opener at Madison Square Garden, capping off a dominant 5-1 performance where the goaltender also contributed 24 saves. Despite attempting similar shots throughout his seven-season career, Shesterkin admitted he was initially unsure if the puck had landed in the net because he was screened by players on the blue line.

For a team coming off a difficult start to the previous season, the win represents a significant shift in momentum. The Rangers opened their current campaign with a 1-1-0 record, showcasing both offensive depth and a perfect 7-for-7 performance on the penalty kill. According to center Mika Zibanejad, the team had specifically discussed the importance of a strong start at home, and seeing their goaltender finally net a goal after several close calls in past games added a memorable highlight to the victory.

The game served as a breakthrough for the Rangers' roster, which saw newcomer Pavel Dorofeyev record his first two points with the team. Other goal contributors included Mika Zibanejad and Eeli Tolvanen. While this stands as the 21st time a goaltender has scored in NHL history—including postseason play—it remains a landmark moment for the franchise. Shesterkin noted that despite his hesitation to celebrate immediately, he intends to keep trying to score in the future.

Following the win against Tampa Bay, the Rangers continue their early-season schedule as they look to build on this performance. Fans at Madison Square Garden greeted the milestone with loud chants of the goaltender's name as he moved to lead the team in their post-game celebrations.

article.headline: Barkov exits in second game back after awkward fall against Sharks
article.summary: Panthers captain Aleksander Barkov left Thursday's game against San Jose in the second period following a fall, just days into his return from a torn ACL and MCL that sidelined him all of last season.
article.body:
Barkov went down awkwardly in the right corner during a power play at 8:07 of the second period against the Sharks at SAP Center. He immediately got up, asked for the Zamboni doors to be opened, and threw his gloves down while walking to the dressing room. The 31-year-old forward appeared to get tripped up during a scrum with Sharks defender Darnell Nurse and forward Zack Ostapchuk along the boards, with his left knee buckling during the play.

The injury is particularly concerning given Barkov's recent medical history. He missed all of the 2025-26 season after tearing his ACL and MCL in his right knee on the first day of training camp, undergoing surgery the following day. Despite the layoff, he led Finland to gold at the 2026 IIHF World Championship in Switzerland in May, serving as captain with 11 points in 10 games.

Barkov had expressed confidence about his recovery before this season. "I have a better feeling going toward this camp knowing that I played some hockey, meaningful hockey, and felt good there," he said in September. He played 20:32 in Tuesday's season opener, a 1-0 overtime win against the Carolina Hurricanes. He captained the Panthers to back-to-back Stanley Cup Championships in 2024 and 2025 and carries 782 points in 806 regular-season games since being drafted second overall in 2013.

The announcement of the €8.5 billion package holds significant weight for taxpayers as officials weigh specific allocations against these widespread household pressures. Minister for Finance Simon Harris has indicated that the tax strategy will focus on individuals who work long hours, with €1.5 billion specifically earmarked for tax cuts. According to The Irish Times, the official budget speech is scheduled for Tuesday, October 6. In the immediate aftermath, a panel of experts from PwC and The Irish Times will begin responding to specific taxpayer inquiries regarding how the new measures will affect net pay, disability supports, and inheritance tax. This match marks a significant moment for Mexico under the leadership of Rafael Márquez, who was appointed manager in July. article.body:
Andrew Garfield spent his film debut constantly waiting for director and co-star Robert Redford, who maintained a famously relaxed attitude toward the shooting schedule. While the younger actor stood ready to film scenes for the 2007 war drama Lions for Lambs, Redford would frequently roll in hours behind, operating entirely on his own internal clock. Garfield admits that while he was initially a bundle of nerves as a 23-year-old newcomer, the long waits eventually helped dissolve his professional anxiety. The environment on set shifted from high-pressure tension to a more casual atmosphere, defined by Redford’s effortless demeanor and preference for denim-on-denim attire.

This insight into the production offers a glimpse into the working habits of a Hollywood titan who remained influential until his death at age 89. For fans of the industry, the anecdote humanizes the process behind a serious political film featuring stars like Tom Cruise and Meryl Streep. It highlights the stark contrast between the disciplined, perfectionist nature of a major movie set and the unpredictable, loose style of a legend like Redford.

Speaking on Amy Poehler’s Good Hang podcast, Garfield clarified that he recounts these experiences with genuine affection. Despite the significant delays, Redford maintained a collaborative spirit, frequently asking the young Garfield for his honest opinion on specific takes. This collaborative approach made a lasting impression on the Spider-Man actor, even if it meant adjusting to a pace that kept the rest of the cast and crew waiting for hours on end.
